## About
Cooper Plumbing is a family-owned and operated company based in Northwest Houston. We work on homes and commercial properties across the area, from Cypress and Bridgeland to the Heights, Katy, Spring and The Woodlands.
We know a repair can be stressful. Our values are simple: structure, communication, honesty, teamwork, respect, energetic persistence and adaptability. In practice that means a professional, respectful visit every step of the way.
Our neighbors have given us a 4.8 rating from 592 Google reviews, and we work to keep earning it one job at a time.

## Services
- Water heater repair and replacement: Repair and replacement for gas, electric and tankless water heaters, plus help choosing the right unit for your property.
- Drain cleaning: Help diagnosing and clearing drain problems, from clogged toilets to clogged main drain lines.
- Gas line repair and installation: Gas line repairs and new installations, including permits.
- Sewer line replacement and repair: Professional sewer line replacement and repair for Houston homes, handled from start to finish.
- Repiping: Horizontal and whole house repipes, handled turn-key from start to finish.
- Leak detection: A high water bill, water stains you can't explain or standing water can all point to a hidden leak. Our technicians are fully certified to track it down.
- Plumbing repairs and installation: Leaky faucets, running toilets, low water pressure and new installations.
- Whole house plumbing inspection: A full look at your home's plumbing so you know where things stand.
- Commercial plumbing repair: Plumbing repair for commercial properties.
- Emergency plumbing issues: Help with urgent problems like flooding, standing water and burst pipes.

## FAQ
Q: What brand of water heater do you install?
A: We install Bradford White water heaters. They are made in the United States and chosen for durability and quality.

Q: How long does a water heater installation take?
A: On average, 2 to 5 hours. The size of the heater, where it sits (attic, garage or utility room), any required code upgrades and removing the old tank can all affect the time.

Q: What does a water heater replacement usually cost?
A: The average runs $1100 to $3000, depending on the type of unit, where it is installed and whether code upgrades are needed. These are averages, so your actual cost may differ.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We are based in Northwest Houston and serve neighborhoods including Cypress, Bridgeland, Towne Lake, Copperfield, Jersey Village, the Heights, Oak Forest, Garden Oaks, Montrose, Spring, Tomball, The Woodlands, Katy and others.

Q: How do I schedule a visit?
A: Call us at 832-441-9683, schedule online, or email cooperplumbinghouston@gmail.com and we will get back to you as soon as possible.
